jobs_results.title: Lead .NET Developer
jobs_results.description:
Company

BICS have been keeping the world’s communication going for nearly two decades, providing mobile operators and enterprises easy access to digital communications, trusted fraud prevention and analytics, IoT and 5G global connectivity. With Headquarters in Europe and teams all over the world, BICS is connecting the world by creating reliable and secure mobile experiences anytime, anywhere.

Descrpition

Tasks:
• Lead the .NET Development team
• Support business in creating a Roadmap for your products
• Be an Agile coach
• Own and maintain a capacity plan for your team
• Be a visioner and owner of the technical roadmap of the team
• Drive DevOps processes and contribute to DevOps practices in the whole organization
• Maintain a healthy and cooperative micro-climate in your team
• Design and implement solutions to fulfill requirements described in User Stories
• Take an active participation in architectural and design discussions
• Peer Code Review using GitLab

Must-have:
•... Proven experience of 1-2+ years as a Team Lead
• 4+ years as .NET Developer
• Strong knowledge of .NET framework and C#
• PhD or Master's degree in a field of information technologies
• Deep understanding of OOP principals
• Strong knowledge of MS SQL databases
• Strong knowledge of WCF Webservices and their hosting environment
• Excellent communication skills
• Strong agile mindset
• Languages: fluent English

Nice-to-have:
• Experience with GIT or a similar versioning system
• Working experience with such technologies as WPF, TPL, LINQ
• Understanding concepts of design patterns such as DI, MVC, MVVM
• Experience with ORMs such as Entity Framework or NHibernate
• Security minded. Familiar with secure IT delivery
• Experience in delivering containerized software
• Experience in the public cloud (Azure and AWS)

Benefits and conditions:
• Trial period: 4 months
• A competitive base salary and short-term incentives
• Yearly bonus
• Comprehensive insurance including hospitalization insurance, outpatient care insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and travel insurance, fully funded by BICS
• Reimbursement of public transport or parking costs
• A telco pack at home including internet allowance and a mobile phone
• 22 vacation days

Interview process:
• Intro call with Toughbyte
• Interview with HR
• Interview with HM
• Tech interview

jobs_results.title: Fullstack developer (.NET / Javascript)
jobs_results.description:
Descripción del puesto

Desde The Whiteam Consulting seleccionamos un/a fullstack developer con experiencia en .Net y Javascript.

Conocimientos técnicos requeridos:
• .NET
• C#
• HTML, Javascript, CSS
• PL/SQL (Oracle)

Conocimientos técnicos deseables:
• Angular
• C++
• Oracle/Forms

Titulación requerida: Grado superior

Trabajo en modalidad híbrida (2 días de presencialidad a elegir L, X o V por la mañana en Pº Castellana. Horario obligatorio de 9 a 14 horas, resto a elegir.

Compañía

Formar parte de THEWHITEAM es colaborar con una empresa formada por profesionales con una dilatada experiencia en consultoría tecnológica.

Creemos firmemente que las empresas y clientes marcan el camino a seguir en el sector, pero éste lo construyen las personas. Consideramos de vital importancia que nuestra organización se fundamente en nuestro mejor activo y marca de valor añadido que es nuestro equipo humano.

Beneficios

Por otra parte, te dejo también un pequeño resumen de políticas de la... compañía para que nos vayas conociendo un poco mejor:
• Nuestro convenio es el de Consultoras y estudios de mercado
• Tenemos 23 días de vacaciones al año
• La empresa da como regalo el día de nuestro cumpleaños, para que podamos disfrutar de él sin trabajar
• Tenemos 14 pagas, 12 mensuales y dos extras (junio y diciembre)
• Como retribución flexible podemos pedir ticket guardería y también seguro médico + dental

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer JAVA Y .NET
jobs_results.description:
En Getronics queremos ampliar nuestro equipo incorporando a un/a Backed Developer para una compañía líder dedicada al ámbito del transporte marítimo de personas y mercancías, en modalidad híbrida (20% en remoto) cuyas oficinas están localizadas en Madrid y Barcelona con horario de entrada flexible y los viernes y los meses de julio y agosto jornada intensiva.

La persona que se incorpore nos ayudará dando soporte de desarrollo y mantenimiento de las aplicaciones de gestión logística y transporte.

REQUISITOS:
• Experiencia mínima en de 4 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software con tecnologías .Net y Java.
• Experiencia desarrollando con HTML, WEB Services y MS SQL.

Se valorará positivamente tener experiencia o conocimientos del:
• Sector logístico, en concreto transporte terrestre y almacenes.

¿QUÉ OFRECEMOS?
• Podrás crearte tu propio plan de formación, seleccionando tus propios contenidos entre una plataforma propia con más de 15.000 opciones a tu alcance, entre las que... encontrarás contenidos acerca de las últimas tecnologías, metodologías ágiles, finanzas personales o salud mental, entre muchas otras opciones.
• Estabilidad, ya que formarás parte de una empresa con 130 años de historia y 4.000 empleados en 23 países, de los cuales, 1.800 están en España.
• Crecimiento profesional. Tendrás acceso a todas las vacantes de Getronics por si quieres dar un salto en tu carrera. Además, ponemos a tu disposición GetLead, un programa destinado a acompañar en el camino a nuestros futuros líderes.
• Formarás parte de un gran equipo con el que crecer día a día.
• Podrás acogerte a retribución flexible para que puedas beneficiarte de aquello que más se ajuste a tus necesidades: ticket restaurante, guardería, transporte, seguro privado.

Si consideras que la posición encaja con tu perfil y cumples con los requisitos indicados, ¡INSCRÍBETE AHORA! Estamos deseando conocerte

jobs_results.title: .NET Architect
jobs_results.description:
We are growing quickly in Europe, and we are currently hiring a NET Architect to work with a multi-disciplinary team of software developers, subject matter experts and solutions architects to deliver cloud-based mobility solutions for our customers.

If you also have 4+ years of experience in Azure, .NET (C#) and React, and enjoy contributing with a team of diverse engineers spread across remote locations.

What you'll do:
• Adhere to high-quality development principles while delivering solutions on-time and on-budget.
• Provide technical support to ensure that all functionality is properly designed, developed, tested, and delivered as per the requirements.
• Develop high-level and low-level design document to be used by team members for development.
• Actively participate in code reviews to ensure coding standards are enforced and adequate code coverage is maintained.
• Diagnose and resolve issues in our dev, test, and production environments.
• - Align with product roadmap and... backlogs, planning necessary throughput, and capacity.
• – with the team to deliver the committed projects, on time within budget with quality, help manage changes/disruptions to the team, partner with other managers/teams adhering to best practices, process and audit constraints.
• – keep both stakeholders and team informed on status, issues and risks.
• Ensure internal company policies are followed on-time and accurately.

What we’re looking for:
• C1
• or Ph.D. in Computer Science, or related discipline.
• years of experience in cloud technologies and software development: microservices, test automation tools, CI pipelines, Cloud, and containerization technologies.
• years of experience in C# (.Net Framework and .Net Core) and React: writing well-designed, high-quality code.
• knowledge of software engineering principles (programming patterns, standard algorithms, data structures, multiprocessing).
• design skills and experience in writing high performance database queries.
• experience in setting up and operating in scaled and distributed environments.

We'd be particularly excited if you have:
• communication skills. Used to interact with client and application end-users.
• on knowledge of AWS, PHP or GoLang.
• driving leadership behavior shifts needed to empower agile teams
• B2 or upper.

Who we are...

We believe there is significant opportunity to further expand into Europe. We have established our European headquarters in Amsterdam, from which we have launched our tolling and violation management solution business in Europe in 2019. We further have offices in London, Paris, Madrid, and Budapest, with a workforce of close to 100 people.

Our European tolling business has established relationships with tolling authorities throughout Spain, Portugal, France, Italy, and Ireland, through which we offer interoperable electronic tolling directly to consumers, through white-label partnerships and to RAC customers, depending on location.

Additionally, our European violations business specializes in the identification, notification, and collection of unpaid traffic, parking and public transport related fees, charges, and penalties issued to foreign registered vehicles or persons on behalf of issuing authorities in more than 17 European countries. We provide our services in more than 20 languages and more than 10 currencies and to leverage existing connections with approximately 30 vehicle licensing authorities and over 600 toll and ticket-issuing authorities for whom we bill violators in more than 135 countries
